title: Sleep quality score
text: Score last night from 0 to 100 on waking, counting awakenings and how rested you feel. There is no published limit; the value only moves the personal baseline.
Repeated poor quality with daytime sleepiness goes to the crew medical officer.
design_note: Baseline scoring only: no published single-reading limit.

citations.title: The Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index: A New Instrument for Psychiatric Practice and Research
